selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用翡翠之花或青翠之拥治疗你自己会使你下一个活化烈焰的施法时间缩短40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Casting Emerald Blossom or Verdant Embrace reduces the cast time of your next Living Flame by 40%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 飞向一名盟友，与其一同飞到目标地点。清除你和盟友受到的移动限制效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Swoop to an ally and fly with them to the target location. Clears movement impairing effects from you and your ally.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑曜鳞片可以多使用一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Obsidian Scales has an additional charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 翡翠之花额外治疗2名盟友。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Emerald Blossom heals 2 additional allies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
增辉
造成和受到的治疗效果提高2%。

 湮灭,  恩护
造成和受到的治疗效果提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Augmentation
Your healing done and healing received are increased by 2%.

 Devastation,  Preservation
Your healing done and healing received are increased by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 给盟友的伤口加热，移除所有流血、中毒、诅咒和疾病效果。移除任何效果后恢复([350% of Spell Power])点生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Cauterize an ally's wounds, removing all Bleed, Poison, Curse, and Disease effects. Heals for (350% of Spell Power) upon removing any effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 活化烈焰造成的伤害和治疗效果提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Living Flame deals 3% more damage and healing.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 压迫怒吼从每个敌人身上移除1个激怒效果，冷却时间缩短30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Oppressing Roar removes 1 Enrage effect from each enemy, and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 对你前方锥形区域内的敌人发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，在接下来的10秒内使影响他们的群体控制持续时间提高50%。 [震魂摄魄: 从每个敌人身上移除1个激怒效果。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Let out a bone-shaking roar at enemies in a cone in front of you, increasing the duration of crowd controls that affect them by 50% in the next 10 sec. [Overawe: Removes 1 Enrage effect from each enemy]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恩护,  增辉
你的耐力提高6%。

 湮灭
你的耐力提高8%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Preservation,  Augmentation
Your Stamina is increased by 6%.

 Devastation
Your Stamina is increased by 8%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 强化你的鳞片，使受到的伤害降低30% [新生光焰: ，并在8秒内恢复相当于所阻挡伤害量的生命值]。持续12秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reinforce your scales, reducing damage taken by 30% [Renewing Blaze: and causing you to be healed over 8 sec equal to the damage it prevented]. Lasts 12 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在目标位置召唤层层山岩，将敌人定身，持续15秒。任何伤害都有可能打断该效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Conjure a path of shifting stone towards the target location, rooting enemies for 15 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 净除一名盟友沾染的毒素，移除其所有中毒效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Expunge toxins affecting an ally, removing all Poison effects.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 火焰吐息的持续性伤害效果延长4秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你造成的魔法伤害提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Magic damage done is increased by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你对自己施放活化烈焰和翡翠之花时，效果提高30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Living Flame and Emerald Blossom are 30% more effective on yourself.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
湮灭,  恩护
裂解的引导速度加快20%。

 增辉
裂解的引导速度加快20%，喷发的施法时间缩短20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Augmentation
Disintegrate channels 20% faster and Eruption's cast time is reduced by 20%.

 Devastation,  Preservation
Disintegrate channels 20% faster.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 储存你有效治疗量的20%，最多不超过(法术强度 * 2.254 * 1)点。你的下一个伤害性活化烈焰会消耗所有已储存的治疗量，造成额外的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Store 20% of your effective healing, up to (Spell Power * 2.254 * 1). Your next damaging Living Flame consumes all stored healing to increase its damage dealt.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 飞向一个盟友，为其恢复([1719% of Spell Power])点生命值，或为你恢复等量的生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fly to an ally and heal them for (1719% of Spell Power), or heal yourself for the same amount.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 火焰吐息会使你的下一个活化烈焰命中额外的目标，每级蓄力增加一个。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fire Breath causes your next Living Flame to strike 1 additional target per empower level.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 新生光焰会更高效的治疗你，在4秒内恢复等同于你所受到伤害的生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Renewing Blaze restores you more quickly, causing damage you take to be healed back over 4 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤上升气流，将你和20码内最近的4位盟友托举到空中，使你们受到的范围攻击伤害降低20%，移动速度提高30%，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Conjure an updraft to lift you and your 4 nearest allies within 20 yds into the air, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 20% and increasing movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 绿龙法术治疗效果提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Green spells restore 5% more health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 翡翠之花和青翠之拥在施放时使你立即恢复([250% of Spell Power])点生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Emerald Blossom and Verdant Embrace instantly heal you for (250% of Spell Power) when cast.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 悬空的持续时间延长4秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Hover lasts 4 sec longer.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 压缩时间，使你下一个蓄力法术变为瞬发，且为最高蓄力等级。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Compress time to make your next empowered spell cast instantly at its maximum empower level.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 扭曲时间，使你和40码内的盟友能够在接下来的10秒内施放一次主要移动技能，无视其冷却状态。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Bend time, allowing you and your allies within 40 yds to cast their major movement ability once in the next 10 sec, even if it is on cooldown.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 悬空额外获得1次使用次数。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Hover gains 1 additional charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑曜鳞片用新生光焰环绕着你，将所阻挡伤害的100%转化为治疗效果，持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Obsidian Scales surrounds you with a Renewing Blaze, causing 100% of the damage it prevented to be healed back over 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 红龙法术造成的伤害和治疗效果额外提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Red spells deal 20% additional damage and healing.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 火焰吐息和深呼吸会治疗附近5名受伤的盟友，效果相当于对最多5个目标所造成伤害的80%，由治疗的所有盟友均摊。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fire Breath and Deep Breath heal 5 nearby injured allies for 80% of damage done to up to 5 targets, split evenly among them.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 精华迸发叠加2次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Essence Burst stacks 2 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 活化烈焰有20%的几率，逆转有15%的几率使你下一个消耗精华的技能不产生消耗。 [精华协调: 可以叠加1次。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Living Flame has a 20% chance, and Reversion has a 15% chance to make your next Essence ability free. [Essence Attunement: Stacks 1 times]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 吸一口气，积聚梦境的力量，然后喷吐而出，为你和你前方40码锥形范围内的5名受伤盟友恢复[([92.16% of Spell Power]) + ([53.52% of Spell Power]) * (8 + 0)]点生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Inhale, gathering the power of the Dream. Release to exhale, healing yourself and 5 injured allies in a 40 yd cone in front of you for [(92.16% of Spell Power) + (53.52% of Spell Power) * (8 + 0)].

subSpellsCn.name: I：
subSpellsCn.description: 立即恢复([92.16% of Spell Power])点生命值，并在(16 + 0)秒内恢复[([53.52% of Spell Power]) * (8 + 0)]点生命值。

subSpellsCn.name: II：
subSpellsCn.description: 立即恢复[([92.16% of Spell Power]) + ([53.52% of Spell Power]) * 2]点生命值，并在(12 + 0)秒内恢复[([53.52% of Spell Power]) * (6 + 0)]点生命值。

subSpellsCn.description: 立即恢复[([92.16% of Spell Power]) + ([53.52% of Spell Power]) * 4]点生命值，并在(8 + 0)秒内恢复[([53.52% of Spell Power]) * (4 + 0)]点生命值。

subSpellsEn.name: I:
subSpellsEn.description: Heals (92.16% of Spell Power) instantly and [(53.52% of Spell Power) * (8 + 0)] over (16 + 0) sec.

subSpellsEn.description: Heals [(92.16% of Spell Power) + (53.52% of Spell Power) * 2] instantly and [(53.52% of Spell Power) * (6 + 0)] over (12 + 0) sec.

subSpellsEn.name: III:
subSpellsEn.description: Heals [(92.16% of Spell Power) + (53.52% of Spell Power) * 4] instantly and [(53.52% of Spell Power) * (4 + 0)] over (8 + 0) sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每施放一个青铜龙法术，都会使你的下一个蓄力法术达到最高级的时间缩短10%。最多叠加4次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each cast of a Bronze spell causes your next empower spell to reach maximum level in 10% less time, stacking up to 4 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 梦境吐息的冷却时间缩短6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dream Breath's cooldown is reduced by 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 青翠之拥的治疗效果提高40%。此外，该技能不再使你跃向目标，而是向前释放一个梦境幻影。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Verdant Embrace healing is increased by 40%. In addition, it no longer causes you to leap to your target, instead sending forth a Dream Simulacrum.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的蓄力法术效果提高10%。引导治疗蓄力法术时，你无法被击退。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your empower spells are 10% more effective. While charging a healing empower spell, you cannot be knocked back.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每当获得精华迸发，你的爆击治疗效果就会变为230%，而非通常的200%，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each time you gain Essence Burst, your critical heals are 230% effective instead of the usual 200% for 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
翡翠之花会在绽开时散播出1颗婆娑幼苗，若治疗的盟友少于3名，则额外散播2颗幼苗。

每颗幼苗为最远40码内的一名盟友恢复([260% of Spell Power])点生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Emerald Blossom sends out 1 flying seedling when it bursts, plus up to 2 additional seedlings if Emerald Blossom heals fewer than 3 allies.

Seedlings each heal an ally up to 40 yds away for (260% of Spell Power).

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每间隔一朵翡翠之花有100%的几率使你的一株婆娑幼苗长成新的翡翠之花。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Every other Emerald Blossom has a 100% chance for one of your Fluttering Seedlings to grow into a new Emerald Blossom.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 梦境吐息的治疗效果提高20%，活化烈焰的治疗效果提高30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dream Breath healing increased by 20%, and Living Flame healing increased by 30%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 青翠之拥会暂时将你的生命与一名盟友联结在一起，使你对你们其中一人产生治疗效果时，该效果可以让另一名伙伴获得60%的治疗。持续8秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Verdant Embrace temporarily bonds your life with an ally, causing your healing on either partner to heal the other for 60% of the amount. Lasts 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 逆转会立即恢复目标在最近5秒内所受伤害的15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reversion instantly heals the target for 15% of damage taken in the last 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
向前发射一道时光能量漩涡，为你和路径中的任意盟友吸收[法术强度 * 6 * (1 + 全能)]点伤害。目标数量超过5个后吸收量降低。

对经过的前5名盟友施加回响，效果为30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Send forward a vortex of temporal energy, absorbing [Spell Power * 6 * (1 + Versatility)] damage on you and any allies in its path. Absorption is reduced beyond 5 targets.

Applies Echo at 30% effectiveness on the first 5 allies it passes through.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 时空畸体使你的蓄力技能的冷却时间缩短5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Temporal Anomaly reduces the cooldowns of your empower spells by 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你对带有你所施放逆转的目标造成的治疗效果提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your healing is increased by 10% on targets with your Reversion.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 裂解额外造成35%的伤害，并在持续时间内产生(2700 * 4)点法力值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Disintegrate deals 35% more damage and generates (2700 * 4) mana over its duration.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 梦境吐息的治疗效果提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dream Breath healing is increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在接下来的8秒内延展一个盟友周围的时空，延缓其即将受到的伤害的50%，改为在8秒内承受。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Stretch time around an ally for the next 8 sec, causing 50% of damage they would take to instead be dealt over 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
回溯40码内所有盟友此前5秒中受到的所有伤害的30%，至少治疗(法术强度 * 0.4 * 5)点生命值。

不在团队中时，治疗量提高200%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Rewind 30% of damage taken in the last 5 seconds by all allies within 40 yds. Always heals for at least (Spell Power * 0.4 * 5).

Healing increased by 200% when not in a raid.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
逆转一名盟友的伤势， [黄金时刻: 立即为其恢复前5秒内受到伤害的15%，并]在12秒内为其恢复([256.5% of Spell Power])点生命值。

当逆转的治疗爆击时，其持续时间延长2秒，最多延长12秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Reverse an ally's injuries, [Golden Hour: instantly healing them for 15% of damage taken in the last 5 sec and an additional / healing them for] (256.5% of Spell Power) over 12 sec.

When Reversion critically heals, its duration is extended by 2 sec, up to a maximum of 12 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 用时光能量封裹一名盟友，为其恢复([240% of Spell Power])点生命值，并使你下一个治疗法术对该盟友额外施放一次，治疗量为正常的[ceil(70 / 时光之主: 105 / 金色机遇: 77)]%。精华法术无法回响。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Wrap an ally with temporal energy, healing them for (240% of Spell Power) and causing your next healing spell to cast an additional time on that ally at [ceil(70 / Time Lord: 105 / Golden Opportunity: 77)]% of normal healing. Essence spells cannot be Echoed.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
湮灭
活化烈焰和碧蓝打击爆击时有额外1次触发精华迸发的机会。

 恩护
活化烈焰爆击时有额外1次触发精华迸发的机会。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Devastation
Living Flame and Azure Strike have 1 extra chance to trigger Essence Burst when they critically strike.

 Preservation
Living Flame has 1 extra chance to trigger Essence Burst when it critically strikes.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
湮灭
裂解造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上1.0秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量150%的伤害。

葬火造成的伤害会消耗受到伤害的敌人身上4秒的火焰吐息效果，并将其引爆，造成相当于消耗量115%的伤害。

 恩护
青翠之拥造成的治疗会消耗受到治疗的盟友身上4秒的梦境吐息效果，并将其引爆，为其恢复相当于消耗量240%的生命值。

翡翠之花和婆娑幼苗造成的治疗会消耗受到治疗的盟友身上2秒的梦境吐息效果，并将其引爆，为其恢复相当于消耗量240%的生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Devastation
Disintegrate consumes 1.0 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 150% of the amount consumed.

Pyre consumes 4 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 115% of the amount consumed.

 Preservation
Verdant Embrace consumes 4 sec of Dream Breath from allies it heals, detonating it and healing them for 240% of the amount consumed.

Emerald Blossom and Fluttering Seedlings consume 2 sec of Dream Breath from allies they heal, detonating it and healing them for 240% of the amount consumed.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恩护
火焰吐息和梦境吐息造成伤害与治疗的频率提高15%。

 湮灭
火焰吐息造成伤害的频率提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Preservation
Fire Breath and Dream Breath deal their damage and healing 15% more often.

 Devastation
Fire Breath deals its damage 15% more often.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑曜鳞片还会施加给目标或附近1个受伤的盟友，产生50%的效果。

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:

Dream Breath's heal over time lasts 6 sec longer.

 恩护

selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Preservation
Fire Breath and Dream Breath reach their maximum empower level 20% faster.

 Devastation

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 对生命值高于50%的目标的爆击几率提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critical strike chance against targets above 50% health increased by 10%.

恩护
梦境吐息和火焰吐息获得一层额外充能。

 湮灭
火焰吐息获得一层额外充能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Preservation
Dream Breath and Fire Breath gain an additional charge.

 Devastation

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 唤醒红龙军团的生命烈焰，以炽热的噬火打击和蔓延烈焰在燃烧敌人的同时滋养盟友。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Commands the life-giving fires of the Red flight, igniting Enkindle flames that burn enemies and soothe wounded allies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 扫尾和飞翼打击会灼烧敌人，并以灰烬令其致盲，使他们在4秒内的下一次攻击无法命中。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet scorch enemies and blind them with ash, causing their next attack within 4 sec to miss.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 火焰吐息的冷却时间缩短5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fire Breath's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 火焰吐息的持续性伤害提高30%。梦境吐息的持续性治疗效果提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fire Breath's damage over time is increased by 30%. Dream Breath's heal over time is increased by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 复制你接下来的3个有益法术，将其存入一道时空谜锁。你可以在30秒内随时重新激活静滞，快速释放出其中的魔法。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Causes your next 3 helpful spells to be duplicated and stored in a time lock. You may reactivate Stasis any time within 30 sec to quickly unleash their magic.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 孪生烈焰会弹射到最多2个额外目标。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Twin Flame bounces to up to 2 additional targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恩护
梦境吐息和火焰吐息有50%的几率产生精华迸发。

 湮灭
火焰吐息有50%的几率产生精华迸发。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Preservation
Dream Breath and Fire Breath have a 50% chance to generate Essence Burst.

 Devastation
Fire Breath has a 50% chance to generate Essence Burst.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
湮灭

subSpellsCn.name: 麦琳瑟拉的祝福
subSpellsCn.description: 从你的目标处绽放生命之花，为其和30码内最多4名其他盟友治疗([225% of Spell Power])点生命值。如果附近没有受伤的盟友，绽放可能会多次治疗你的主要目标。

subSpellsEn.name: Merithra's Blessing
subSpellsEn.description: Spring a bloom of life from your target, healing them and up to 4 other allies within 30 yards for (225% of Spell Power). Blooms may heal your primary target multiple times if no nearby injured allies are present.
